motivation.mechanism: test whether pre-existing Gold volatility and bid-ask liquidity state predicts the magnitude of the next hour, before attempting any directional or executable strategy
orthogonal_to_closed_lanes: gold-silver relative value and ratio momentum
scheduled macro reaction continuation versus reversal
literature_notes: Intraday gold volatility is forecastable from prior intraday realized-volatility information.
Commodity bid-ask spreads are related to volatility and market quality.
Gold intraday liquidity and volatility exhibit strong time-of-day seasonality, so every raw state variable is compared with a trailing same-clock baseline where applicable.

state_variables.pre_rv_ratio: pre-60m realized volatility divided by trailing 20-observation same-clock median pre-60m realized volatility
state_variables.spread_level_ratio: pre-15m median relative spread divided by trailing 20-observation same-clock median pre-15m spread
state_variables.spread_deterioration_ratio: pre-15m median relative spread divided by preceding 45m median relative spread
state_variables.pre_range_ratio: pre-60m high-low range divided by trailing 20-observation same-clock median pre-60m range
state_variables.negative_semivariance_share: sum of squared negative one-minute pre-window midpoint log returns divided by total pre-window realized variance

targets.future_rv_ratio: next-60m realized volatility divided by trailing 20-observation same-clock median next-60m realized volatility
targets.future_range_ratio: next-60m high-low range divided by trailing 20-observation same-clock median next-60m range

primary_hypotheses.statistic: median New-York-date partial Spearman(feature, future_rv_ratio | pre_rv_ratio)
median New-York-date partial Spearman(feature, future_rv_ratio | pre_rv_ratio)
median New-York-date partial Spearman(feature, future_rv_ratio | pre_rv_ratio)
median New-York-date partial Spearman(feature, future_rv_ratio | pre_rv_ratio)

statistics.permutation_method: two-sided sign-flip test on daily correlation or partial-correlation effects
statistics.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across all five primary hypotheses
